web.title: BERC to hold public hearing today on gas price hike
web.description: # BERC to hold public hearing today on gas price hike Published : 25 February 2025 Updated : 26 February 2025, 02:35 Staff Correspondent The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) is set to hold a public hearing today on the proposals to increase gas prices for industrial users, according to a notice from the commission. The hearing will take place at the capital's BIAM auditorium from 10:00am to 5:00pm.

web.title: LPG traders call off strike after BERC sets 29 October hearing
web.description: LPG traders call off strike after BERC sets 29 October hearing ... LPG traders have withdrawn a nationwide two-day strike after the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) fixed 29 October for a public hearing. The LP Gas Traders Cooperative Society Limited had called the strike for Thursday and Friday (15 and 16 October) on a seven-point list of demands, including a rise in their commission. It decided to withdraw it after a stern warning from the government and an assurance from BERC. ... BERC will try to adjust LPG prices through the public hearing on 29 October.
